findings.evidence: `CreateMDLView` is updated to `CREATE OR REPLACE SQL SECURITY INVOKER ...` (`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:463`), but `currentBootstrapVersion` remains `version198` (`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:1104`). The view is only recreated during upgrade when `ver < version197` via `upgradeToVer197` (`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:3103`); `upgradeToVer198` does not recreate the view (`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:3111`). If `ver >= currentBootstrapVersion`, `upgrade()` exits without any DDL (`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:1378`).
findings.fix: Add a new bootstrap version (e.g. `version199`) and an `upgradeToVer199` that runs `doReentrantDDL(s, CreateMDLView)` to force-replace `mysql.tidb_mdl_view` for all existing clusters. (Alternative: add a dedicated upgrade step that only recreates this view and bump `currentBootstrapVersion` accordingly.)
findings.impact: Clusters already bootstrapped at `ver >= 197` before deploying this change may keep the old `mysql.tidb_mdl_view` definition (without `SQL SECURITY INVOKER`), so the intended privilege/visibility hardening may not take effect, leaving the original exposure in place until manual intervention or a future upgrade step.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` (b75374faa619e24e380292fdbdf0f6fe5bf11943): `metadef.CreateTiDBMDLView` is still only executed in `upgradeToVer94`/`132`/`193`/`197` (`pkg/session/upgrade_def.go:1449`, `pkg/session/upgrade_def.go:1547`, `pkg/session/upgrade_def.go:1802`, `pkg/session/upgrade_def.go:1819`), with no newer upgrade version that forces replacement for clusters already bootstrapped at >=197.
findings.verify: On an already-bootstrapped cluster, run `SHOW CREATE VIEW mysql.tidb_mdl_view` and confirm it includes `SQL SECURITY INVOKER`. Then verify privilege behavior: an unprivileged user should fail `SELECT * FROM mysql.tidb_mdl_view`, while a sufficiently privileged user should succeed.
findings.what: Security fix may not apply to existing clusters: the bootstrap/upgrade path does not force-replace `mysql.tidb_mdl_view` for clusters already at bootstrap version >=197, so adding `SQL SECURITY INVOKER` in the bootstrap DDL can be a no-op for those upgrades.

subject: session: set sql security of `tidb_mdl_view` to 'invoker' (#53265)
summary: The commit changes the bootstrap CREATE VIEW for `mysql.tidb_mdl_view` to `SQL SECURITY INVOKER` and adds a privilege regression test, but it does not introduce a new bootstrap upgrade step/version to force-replace the view for clusters already bootstrapped at >=197, so the hardening may not take effect for those existing clusters.
